eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: San Luis Obispo, CA; at 8:28 PM on AUG 14, 2016 Effective until 9:28 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
An Evacuation Order has been issued for the residents and the general public in the area of Lake Nacimiento and Running Deer Ranch, from Cow Camp Loop south to Chimney Rock Rd and east to Lake Nacimiento.

 Individuals should leave the area using Running Deer Rd to Chimney Rock Rd. 

A shelter has been established at Flamson Middle School at Spring St & 24th St in Paso Robles.

At such time as the emergency situation changes, the evacuation boundaries are extended, or the emergency no longer exists, you will be promptly advised by another Emergency Alert System Message. 
Listen to local radio and television stations for further information.
